messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
118 అప్పుడు నీవు సంతృప్తిగా ఉన్న వారిని చూస్తావు 119 అగ్నిలో వారు రావాలని ఆశిస్తున్నారు 120 అది ఎప్పుడైనా ఆశీర్వదిత ప్రజలకు చేరుతుంది.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Telugu Translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | **e** | coordinating conjunction “And then” | **అప్పుడు** | “then” | OK | | **vederai** | future verb “you will see” | **చూస్తావు** | “you will see” | OK | | **color** | demonstrative pronoun “those (people)” | **వారిని** | “those (people)” | OK | | **che** (rel. pron.) | relative pronoun “who” | — (integrated in **ఉన్న**) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **son** | copula “are” | **ఉన్న** | “are” | OK | | **contenti** | adjective “contented” | **సంతృప్తిగా** | “contentedly” | OK | | **nel** | preposition “in the” | **అగ్నిలో** | “in fire” | OK | | **foco** | noun “fire” | **అగ్ని** (within **అగ్నిలో**) | “fire” | OK | | **perché** | causal conjunction “because” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **speran** | verb “they hope” | **ఆశిస్తున్నారు** | “they hope” | OK | | **di** | infinitive marker “to” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **venire** | infinitive “come” | **రావాలని** | “to come” | OK | | **quando** | temporal adverb “whenever” | **ఎప్పుడైనా** | “whenever” | OK | | **che** (particle) | idiomatic particle in *quando che* | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **sia** | subjunctive “it may be” | **అది** | “it” (contextual “may be”) | OK | | **a** | preposition “to” (dative) | **కు** (as part of **ప్రజలకు**) | “to” | OK | | **le** | definite article “the” (feminine plural) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **beate** | adjective “blessed” | **ఆశీర్వదిత** | “blessed” | OK | | **genti** | noun “folk, people” | **ప్రజలు** (within **ప్రజలకు**) | “people” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **UNNECESSARY**: - *che* (line 118) – relative pronoun not expressed in Telugu. - *perché* – causal conjunction omitted; Telugu conveys meaning without it. - *di* – infinitive marker omitted. - *che* (line 120) – idiomatic particle omitted. - *le* – definite article omitted (Telugu lacks articles).
All other source words are correctly rendered (OK) with appropriate grammatical agreement.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 118: - Original: **అప్పుడు నీవు సంతృప్తిగా ఉన్న వారిని చూస్తావు** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 119: - Original: **అగ్నిలో వారు రావాలని ఆశిస్తున్నారు** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 120: - Original: **అది ఎప్పుడైనా ఆశీర్వదిత ప్రజలకు చేరుతుంది** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
